    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Binaries
    Utilities on byte arrays.
    Column
    Represents a column in a table.
    ColumnList
    List of columns accessible by alias or by index.
    ColumnList.Interceptor
    Called before a column is added, to configure its properties or to reject it.
    ConnectionFactory
    Opens the physical connections of a ConnectionPool, so that the pool does not need to know the URL, the credentials or the driver properties.
    ConnectionPool
    Connection pool.
    DBConnection
    A simplified JDBC connection with just the methods needed by MSFX.
    DBEngine
    Database engine that represents the back-end system to which we connect through a JDBC driver.
    DBEngineOracle
    Oracle adapter, for the Oracle thin JDBC driver (ojdbc11).
    DBEngineSQLServer
    SQL Server adapter, for the Microsoft JDBC driver (mssql-jdbc).
    DBPreparedStatement
    A simplified JDBC prepared statement with just the methods needed by MSFX.
    DBResultSet
    A simplified JDBC result set, read forward only, with one getter per type of Types, named and typed as in Value.
    DBStatement
    A simplified JDBC statement with just the methods needed by MSFX.
    DBStatementBase
    The methods shared by DBStatement and DBPreparedStatement.
    ForeignKey
    A relation from a local table to a foreign table, made of segments that each pair a local column with a foreign column.
    ForeignKey.Segment
    A segment of the foreign key: a local column and the foreign column it refers to.
    Index
    An index of a table.
    JSONArray
    JSON Array.
    JSONEntry
    An entry value of the JSONObject internal map, or an item of a JSONArray.
    JSONObject
    JSON Object.
    JSONParser
    JSON parser.
    JSONTypes
    JSON types.
    JSONWriter
    A writer of JSON objects.
    Maps
    A collection of utility methods for working with maps.
    Properties
    A useful and quite generic properties table with typed access for commonly used objects.
    Record
    A list of values with their column definitions.
    Strings
    String utilities.
    Table
    A database table, with its columns and indexes.
    Types
    Data types supported and mapped within the supported database engine adapters.
    Value
    A mutable value for the supported types.
